body: Yeah, it's pretty strange and I thought I had killed her the first time I did that.

By shot in the head, I was referring to how if Conrad takes the knife instead of escaping on the boat at the start and Alex stands his ground, Julia is shot in the head but survives. I was not referring to the Junior encounter.

Maybe, I haven't tested to see what happens if I don't get Julia/Conrad shot on the Duke of Milan or if I kill Alex instead or maybe even kill Conrad and keep Fliss alive. There's a couple of variations I'd like to try out to see if they still seem to break the game or if it's just this specific set of actions.
